supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Describe attributes of shapes. Sort shapes based on attributes in a way that makes sense to them.
teachingSteps: Look for attributes named in the task: sides, angles, parallel sides.
Test each attribute even when a figure is rotated.
Justify or revise the classification with a labelled drawing.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Shape type depends on defining properties, not orientation or apparent size.
